rules.description: Ensures payment amounts are not negative.

impact.reason: Negative amounts would corrupt revenue reporting.

rules.description: Verifies payment dates are not in the future.

impact.reason: Future dates may indicate data entry errors.

rules.rule: (payments.payment_status = 'REFUNDED' AND payments.refund_date IS NOT NULL) OR (payments.payment_status <> 'REFUNDED' AND payments.refund_date IS NULL)
rules.description: Refund date must be present only when status is REFUNDED.

impact.reason: Mismatched status/refund dates break financial reconciliation.

rules.rule: payments.refund_date IS NULL OR payments.refund_date >= payments.payment_date
rules.description: When a refund occurs, the refund date cannot precede the payment date.

impact.reason: Inconsistent temporal order could lead to incorrect audit trails.
